environment.description: Service runs on ECS Fargate tasks in an isolated private subnet (no IGW, no NAT attached to route table). Ingress is exclusively through a com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 interface endpoint backed by a Network Load Balancer (internal). The VPC endpoint policy restricts aws:PrincipalOrgID to the organization's OU and the endpoint's security group only permits inbound TCP/443 from CIDR 10.200.0.0/16 (the consumer VPC's allocation). DNS resolution for the service hostname resolves to the VPC endpoint ENI private IPs via Route 53 private hosted zone (no public DNS record exists). The NLB has no public IP and its subnet route table has no 0.0.0.0/0 route. Additionally, the Fargate task's awsvpc ENI is in a security group that only accepts inbound from the NLB's ENI security group (sg-0fedcba987654321) on port 8080.

config.deployment: ECS Fargate in isolated private subnet
config.route_table: local routes only (10.100.0.0/16), no IGW, no NAT
config.nlb_type: internal (no public IP, no internet route)
config.dns: Route 53 private hosted zone, no public record
config.public_accessibility: none - no internet path exists to service
